title: 第一卷 第17章 去码头卖货
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
薛凤看婆婆被怼的不说话，开口说道：“婶子，你这话说的，你怎么知道我们没有管？”

    滕千琴撇撇嘴：“管了有啥用？”

    薛凤说道：“怎么没有用？我还真不是说瞎话。”

    “昨天阿华给我们送海鲜，给了妈零花钱。”

    “他还说自己长大了，老大不小了，以后还有帮着家里分担。”

    滕千琴说道：“我知道你不是编瞎话，阿华肯定是说了这些话，但是这些话你信吗？”

    “他指不定是在外面惹了什么祸，回家哄你们开心，想让你们帮忙。”

    任琴脸色一僵。

    这还真让滕千琴说对了。

    薛凤来气。

    虽然她也瞧不上自己这个小叔子，但是听外人这么说自家人，心里还是很不痛快的。

    就算是李华惹了祸，他们自家人也会帮着解决。

    轮不到外人说三道四的。

    “婶子，你可不要胡说八道，你也是看着阿华长大的，怎么能这么败坏他的名声呢？”

    “阿华的名声还需要我败坏呢？”滕千琴越说越来气，双手叉腰嚷了起来：“说了一堆大话，说是跟着一起赶海，结果怎么着。”

    “3分钟还没过，就找借口跑的没了人影，还把我儿子也带走了。”

    薛凤说道：“你说阿华找借口，你是看到他们没去礁石滩赶海吗？”

    滕千琴一愣：“那，那倒是没有……”

    薛凤喊道：“你没看到，你怎么知道就是借口了？”

    “没准俩人真就去礁石滩赶海了呢？”

    “你这么嚷嚷，那不是冤枉人了？”

    滕千琴：“你还来劲了，还我冤枉他了？你小叔子什么德行？你自己不知道？”

    “你倒是个好嫂子，怪会护犊子。”

    薛凤当然知道李华的德行，但嘴上却是一点也不服软：“阿华说他要正干，我就信。”

    “我不像某些人，什么都没看到，就在这边瞎咧咧。”

    “要不是咱这关系，我非撕了你的嘴。”

    滕千琴：“你来撕，你来撕。”

    薛凤看了一眼婆婆。

    任琴拉着薛凤就走。

    婆媳俩默契配合，滕千琴也没有揪着不放。嘟那两句拎着桶往家里面走，没有让村里人一直看热闹。

    ……

    快到码头。

    碰到刘表几人。

    几人哈欠连天，一看就是打了一夜的牌。

    码头这边热闹，鱼龙混杂，什么人都有，之前李华就跟着刘表在这边玩牌，他去偷人鱼获，就是老陈撺掇的。

    他偷人渔获，卖给老陈。

    老陈要么给他免了赌资，要么就是给他三瓜俩枣。

    最后的结果就是，他成了人人喊打的烂仔，而老陈则轻轻松松的大赚一笔。

    刘表看到李华，笑着招呼道：“华哥，早啊。”
content_en:
Xue Feng saw that her mother-in-law was silent and said, "Auntie, you said this, how do you know we didn't care?"

    Teng Qianqin pouted: "What's the use of taking care of it?"

    Xue Feng said: "Why is it useless? I am really not lying."

    "Ahua gave us seafood yesterday and gave mom pocket money."

    "He also said that he has grown up and that he is no longer a child. He will help the family to share the burden in the future."

    Teng Qianqin said: "I know you are not making up lies. Ah Hua must have said these things, but do you believe them?"

    "He may have caused some trouble outside. He came home to make you happy and wanted you to help."

    Ren Qin's face froze.

    This really makes Teng Qianqin right.

    Xue Feng was angry.

    Although she looked down upon her brother-in-law, she still felt very unhappy when she heard outsiders talk about her family.

    Even if Li Hua gets into trouble, their own family will help solve it.

    It is not the turn of outsiders to make irresponsible remarks.

    "Auntie, don't talk nonsense. You also watched Ah Hua grow up. How could you ruin his reputation like this?"

    "Why do I still need to ruin Ah Hua's reputation?" Teng Qianqin became more and more angry as she spoke, and shouted with her hands on her hips: "I told you a lot of big words, saying that I was going to sea with you, but what happened?"

    "Before 3 minutes passed, he made an excuse and ran away, and took my son away with him."

    Xue Feng said: "You said Ahua made excuses. Did you see that they didn't go to the reef beach to catch the sea?"

    Teng Qianqin was stunned: "Well, that's not true..."

    Xue Feng shouted: "You didn't see it, how did you know it was an excuse?"

    "Maybe the two of them really went to the reef beach to catch the sea?"

    "You are yelling like this, isn't that an injustice?"

    Teng Qianqin: "Are you still excited to repay me for wronging him? What kind of virtue is your brother-in-law? You don't know it yourself?"

    "You are a good sister-in-law, and you know how to protect babies."

    Of course Xue Feng knew about Li Hua's virtues, but he was not convinced at all: "A Hua said he wants to do it right, I believe it."

    "I'm not like some people who don't see anything and just stay blind."

    "If it weren't for our relationship, I would have torn your mouth apart."

    Teng Qianqin: "Tear it apart, tear it apart."

    Xue Feng glanced at her mother-in-law.

    Ren Qin took Xue Feng and left.

    The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law cooperated tacitly, and Teng Qianqin did not hold on to her. With these two words, he carried the bucket and walked home without letting the villagers watch the fun.

    …

    Get to the dock soon.

    I met Liu Biao and several others.

    Several people were yawning, and it looked like they had been playing cards all night.

    The pier was lively and crowded, and everyone was there. Li Hua had been playing cards here with Liu Biao before, and he went to steal the mermaids, which was what Lao Chen had instigated.

    He stole people's catch and sold it to Lao Chen.

    Lao Chen either exempted him from gambling, or gave him three melons and two dates.

    The final result was that he became the bad boy that everyone shouted at, while Lao Chen made a lot of money easily.

    When Liu Biao saw Li Hua, he smiled and said, "Good morning, Brother Hua."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 17 Going to the dock to sell goods
